name: io.github.deBilla/platform-mcp
description: Read-only GCP tools for debugging incidents and finding cost savings

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ENVIRONMENTS
environmentVariables.description: JSON map of environment name to GCP settings. Omit when using a config file at ~/.config/platform-mcp/config.toml.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_DEFAULT_ENVIRONMENT
environmentVariables.description: Environment used when a tool call omits the environment argument.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to a TOML config file, overriding ~/.config/platform-mcp/config.toml.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Path for the JSONL tool-call audit log, or 'off' to disable it.
